releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.57 — group calls, aligned with the server that actually exists. The worker's group-call routes were merged on 3 November and speak a slightly different shape than the app expected: participant names arrive flat (full_name/avatar_url) instead of nested, and join/leave events name the person as user_id instead of from. Both are now read, so the roster shows real names and a participant who hangs up disappears from the list. New: when someone starts a group call, the others get a card — "Nasir started a voice call" — with Join / Not now, instead of having to open the group and hope they noticed. The card expires on its own after 45 seconds and never interrupts a call you are already on.
